high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the account "thisisbillgates." The post was made 17 hours prior to the screenshot being taken on Tuesday, May 27th at 10:13 PM. The battery level is at 100%. The main focus of the image is a book cover for "Educated: A Memoir" by Tara Westover. The book cover features a large pencil with a person standing on top of it, symbolizing education and achievement. The background of the cover includes a mountainous landscape with a gradient of warm colors, suggesting a journey or ascent
